# RouteLocation v1.2.19

### 繁體中文

- 新增隨系統、淺色與深色外觀選項。
- 新增只作用於唯讀座標值的文字大小偏好。
- 調整路線播放卡片，讓目前座標可使用更多橫向空間。
- 地圖收藏選擇器沿用「我的」中的排序與手動順序。
- DDI 改為選用、best-effort 的開發者服務元件；未掛載不會阻止一般定位模擬。
- 將 Health Sync 設定移至獨立頁面，並顯示目前 HealthKit 能力狀態。Health Sync 需要相容簽名，且不影響定位功能。
- 更新繁體中文與英文文件及介面文字。

### English

- Added System, Light, and Dark appearance options.
- Added a text-size preference for read-only coordinate values only.
- Adjusted the Route Player card so the current coordinate has more horizontal room.
- The map favorite picker now follows the sorting and manual order used in My.
- DDI is an optional, best-effort developer-service component; it does not block normal location simulation when unmounted.
- Moved Health Sync settings to a dedicated page and surfaced the current HealthKit capability state. Health Sync requires a compatible signature and does not affect location features.
- Refreshed Traditional Chinese and English documentation and UI text.

Re-sign the unsigned IPA with SideStore, AltStore, TrollStore, or another compatible tool.
